cases.description: 加密文件传输索引连接为什么会停顿以及改过什么等待参数

limits: StarLink in running Linux container versus ripgrep on host macOS, reading the same mounted physical directory; deployed-route comparison, not identical-runtime engine benchmark.
StarLink calls actual installed registered handler and live HTTPS APIs, excludes Go tool admission and host IPC; fulltext includes rg process spawn/output parse.
Both verify original line by reading candidate source files; evaluator knows expected file/anchor but searches never receive either. Not an AI choosing the right candidate or interpreting the source.
No matching coverage: fulltext scans all 1199 files, while snapshot contains 517 file nodes and usually only first 8KiB; fewer candidates is partly reduced coverage, not proven ranking quality.
Whole-file AND terms, query expansion fixed manually before timing; planning/reformulation time not measured. Raw description is one literal phrase, not semantic search.
Warm OS caches; 9 alternating-order repeats per query stage. Cold load observed only once per each of 3 sessions.
First run encountered rg base64 JSON lines and produced no report; parser fixed and entire run restarted.
